movie.title: Cannelloni
movie.overview: Inspired by true events, this is a nocturnal thriller that follows the 2015 kidnapping of Chichita—mother of writer Hernán Casciari—by Daniel Olesnik. Olesnik seeks to settle a blood debt: to avenge a prank played by Hernán and his friend Chiri back in 1987, which drove his own mother to suicide. It is an inescapable, suffocating, and deadly spiral of vengeance that unfolds over the course of a single night.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: In this nocturnal thriller based on true events, a man kidnaps the mother of writer Hernán Casciari to avenge a decades-old childhood prank that ended in tragedy.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Inspired by real events, Daniel Olesnik kidnaps Chichita, the mother of writer Hernán Casciari, during a tense, suffocating night in 2015. Olesnik is driven by a deep-seated desire for vengeance over a 1987 prank orchestrated by Hernán and his friend Chiri that pushed his own mother to suicide. As the night unfolds, long-buried secrets and dark lingering trauma surface in a high-stakes standoff. What begins as a quest for closure quickly spirals into an inescapable and deadly struggle.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: In 2015, a quiet night turns harrowing when Daniel Olesnik orchestrates the calculated kidnapping of Chichita, the elderly mother of renowned writer Hernán Casciari. Driven by bitter resentment, Olesnik seeks to settle a devastating blood debt that has consumed him for nearly three decades. The root of his hatred traces back to 1987, when a seemingly harmless childhood prank played by young Hernán and his best friend Chiri triggered a disastrous sequence of events. That prank ultimately drove Olesnik’s own mother to take her life, fracturing his world and leaving him obsessed with retribution. Confined within the tense, claustrophobic atmosphere of a single night, Chichita must navigate the unhinged psyche of her captor. Meanwhile, the shadow of Hernán’s past choices looms large over the unfolding crisis as the emotional toll of the tragedy comes due. Dark comedic beats intermingle with suffocating suspense as Olesnik forces a confrontation over accountability, grief, and long-standing guilt. As the hours tick away, the escalation of tension brings both captor and hostage closer to a violent point of no return. Ultimately, the night exposes the destructive power of lingering revenge and the irreversible consequences of thoughtless actions.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Inspired by remarkable true events, Cannelloni is a gripping nocturnal thriller that blends tense drama with dark, satirical undertones. The story takes place over the course of one suffocating night in 2015, following the unexpected abduction of Chichita—mother to famous author Hernán Casciari. Her captor, Daniel Olesnik, is a man haunted by a tragic event from 1987, when an ill-fated prank executed by a young Hernán and his friend Chiri resulted in the suicide of Olesnik's mother. Decades later, Olesnik returns to extract a deadly retribution for his family's ruin, trapping Chichita in a psychological game of survival. Blending elements of comedy, drama, and nail-biting suspense, the narrative dives deep into themes of guilt, historical consequences, and the destructive nature of unyielding vengeance.

story_structure.climax: The confrontation reaches a critical tipping point in the dead of night, where the true cost of the past prank comes to a head and Chichita's immediate survival hangs in the balance.
story_structure.conflict: Olesnik kidnaps Chichita to settle a perceived blood debt, forcing Hernán and his family into a desperate race against time to save her while confronting the ghost of their past.
story_structure.resolution: The explosive night reaches its conclusion, leaving the long-standing vendetta addressed and forced to a close amidst the immediate aftermath of the crisis.
story_structure.introduction: Hernán Casciari's mother, Chichita, is abruptly targeted during a single fateful night by Daniel Olesnik, driven by a decades-old grudge dating back to a 1987 prank.
story_structure.risingAction: Tension intensifies over the nocturnal hours as Olesnik's vengeful spiral deepens, trapping the characters in a suffocating psychological game with mounting stakes.
